used_when: voice_config ota_url is set (our own DRADUCK voice server) and data/draduck.json chooses {"wake": "short"}, or the main model draduck_nee.onnx is missing

trainer.name: livekit-wakeword
trainer.note: Same commit and frontends as xiaoya.onnx. Steps after augmentation were run by draduck_wakeword/train_steps.py, because run_extraction needs SessionOptions at this commit.

data.positives: ドラダック (also with ！？、 and ねえ) from OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts, 13 voices x 12 speaking styles, and 9 macOS Japanese voices, each also played at 0.85-1.26x; filtered with SenseVoice; 5044 train / 829 test clips, test voices held out (verse, cedar, Sandy)
data.negatives: 40 near misses (ドラッグ, トラック, ドラマ, ダック, どら焼き…) and about 400 everyday Japanese sentences in the same voices, 5211 train / 914 test; plus ACAV100M features (2000 h), MUSAN noise and MIT room impulse responses

evaluation.stream_test_2026_11_13: Luwu's wakeword_manager code over new audio: 30/30 wake sentences in held-out voices, 0 false wakes in 2.5 min of everyday talk dense with near misses, at 0.6 and 0.7
evaluation.not_yet: real voices (adults, children) through the duck's own microphone
evaluation.stream_test_2026_11_13_family: Same cached audio as the other DRADUCK models (30 ねえ、ドラダック and 30 ドラダック in held-out voices, 7.6 min family talk, 3.8 min packed near misses): at 0.6, 30/30 + 30/30 and 3 false wakes on the near misses (ドラッグストア, トラック, ドラちゃん); at 0.7, 29/30 + 30/30 and none
